result.note: A one-line diplomatic protest over a naval collision; only the location and India's diplomatic response are testable.

questions.prompt: In September 2026, India summoned Pakistan's charge d'affaires after a Pakistan Navy vessel collided with an Indian ship. Where did the collision take place?
questions.explain: The collision between a Pakistan Navy vessel and an Indian ship took place in the Arabian Sea on 17 September 2026. India summoned Pakistan's charge d'affaires and called the conduct unacceptable and unprofessional.
questions.source: India summoned Pakistan's charge d'affaires after a Pakistan Navy vessel collided with an Indian ship in the Arabian Sea, calling the conduct unacceptable and unprofessional.
